29 May 2026

Display Indirect TDS Summary in Invoice and Bill PDFsFeatured

Indirect TDS Summary is now displayed in Invoice and Bill PDFs when applicable, showing the TDS rate, taxable amount, and total TDS amount.

29 May 2026

Additional Language SupportFeatured

We now support three additional languages, Korean, Polish, and Greek in Zoho Books.

27 May 2026

Bulk Update Support for Item Reporting TagsFeatured

Bulk Update for items now supports Reporting Tags, allowing you to update reporting tag in bulk across your items.

25 May 2026

Attach Annexure to PDF TemplatesFeatured

You can now attach annexure documents to your PDF templates. Supporting documents are automatically appended as additional pages at the end of the generated PDF.

25 May 2026

TDS Liability Filters for ChallansFeatured

TDS Liability Filters are now available while recording TDS Challans, enabling you to filter by Transaction Type, TDS sections, Vendor, Date Range, and Location.

25 May 2026

Associate Price List with LocationsFeatured

Price lists with the Sales Transaction Type can now be associated with Business Locations. While creating transactions, pricing is automatically applied based on a hierarchy. If a price list is associated with the customer, it takes precedence. Otherwise, the price list linked to the selected location applies automatically.

21 May 2026

Support for Alias Name in Items List viewFeatured

The Alias Name column is now available in the Items list view page.

21 May 2026

Partial ReplenishmentFeatured

We now support partial replenishment for inventory restocking tasks. If the quantity in an order created from a replenishment task is below the required quantity, a new replenishment task is automatically created with the pending quantities. This feature is only available in Zoho Inventory Add-on enabled organisations.

19 May 2026

Display Total Amount Excluding TDS in Invoice PDFsFeatured

You can now display the Total Amount Excluding TDS in the totals section of an invoice PDF, allowing you to show the invoice amount without TDS alongside the total amount. [India & Singapore Edition]

19 May 2026

Sync Sales Return from Shopify to Zoho BooksFeatured

You can now sync your Sales Returns from Shopify to Zoho Books.

12 May 2026

Compare Locations Within a Single HierarchyFeatured

You can now compare locations within a single hierarchy in Reports.

07 May 2026

Filter Custom Reports by Date RangeFeatured

You can now apply date range filters to Custom Reports.

05 May 2026

Units GroupsFeatured

With Unit Groups, conversions are now managed at the group level, and each group can be associated with a specific Item. This means you can create multiple conversion rates for the same base and target units by defining separate unit groups. For example, if you sell cookies in boxes of 5 and cupcakes in boxes of 8, you can now create distinct unit groups for each, even though both use pieces as the base unit and box as the target unit.

05 May 2026

Layout Rules for Custom ModulesFeatured

We have introduced layout rules for Custom Modules. You can now define conditions so that fields appear or hide, become mandatory, or get auto-filled based on the values entered.

05 May 2026

Custom Report Permissions for AdminsFeatured

Admins now have full access to Custom Reports, with permissions to edit, clone, and delete any report in the organization.

05 May 2026

Auto Batch AssignmentFeatured

Managing inventory batches manually during every outward transaction can be time-consuming and error-prone. With the Auto Batch Assignment feature, Zoho Books intelligently identifies and assigns inventory batches automatically based on a configured allocation strategy. You can choose from FIFO (oldest stock first), FEFO (earliest expiry first), or LIFO (latest stock first). This feature is only available in Zoho Inventory Add-on enabled organizations.

28 April 2026

Enhancement to TDS Challan ExportFeatured

We have introduced the option to filter challans by payment date range, allowing you to export only the challans that fall within the selected challan payment date range.

28 April 2026

Retain Vendor Advance While Deleting Bill PaymentsFeatured

When deleting bill payments linked to vendor advances, you can now use the Dissociate and Add as Credit option to retain the amount as a Vendor Advance and apply it to future transactions.

28 April 2026

Scan Receipts for FreeFeatured

Receipt Scans are now available for free in Zoho Books.

21 April 2026

Include Child Options in Report FiltersFeatured

Advanced Filters in Reports now support the Include Child Options setting for reporting tags, allowing all associated child options to be automatically included in the report filter.

17 April 2026

Import TDS Columns in Applied Excess Vendor PaymentsFeatured

We have added support for importing TDS-related columns in the Applied Excess Vendor Payment import.

14 April 2026

Filter Items by Warehouse in Purchase ReceivesFeatured

We have introduced a warehouse filter in the Purchase Receive creation page to help users easily filter and receive items based on the warehouse associated with each line item in a Purchase Order. This feature is only available in Zoho Inventory Add-on enabled organisations.

13 April 2026

Introducing AI Custom Field Data TypesFeatured

We’ve added AI-driven custom fields: Image to Text, Keyword Extraction, and Sentiment Analysis. These fields can extract text from images, identify keywords, and analyze sentiment (Positive, Negative, or Neutral) to help organize data and gain quick insights.

08 April 2026

Customise Accessibility PreferencesFeatured

We have introduced Accessibility Preferences in Zoho Books. You can now adjust text spacing, underline links for better visibility, add strikethrough to disabled buttons, and quickly access keyboard shortcuts for easier navigation.

08 April 2026

Customise Organisation Details in Report ExportsFeatured

We have introduced support for displaying organisation details in report export files. Using the Configure Report Layout option, you can now customise organisation details for both standard and custom reports, and also modify these details during report export.

06 April 2026

Configure User-Level Account Segmentation in BankingFeatured

Admins can now assign specific bank accounts to individual users based on their roles, ensuring users can access and manage only the bank accounts explicitly allocated to them.
